description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case. These functions are used across the application to ensure consistent string rendering in the UI.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling delimiters like spaces, underscores, and hyphens, and collapsing multiple spaces. Returns the original value if not a string.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, capitalizing the first letter of each word and after apostrophes, replacing delimiters with spaces and collapsing multiple spaces. Returns the original value if not a string.
